SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET COMPANY, KEY_1 DOCU_NO FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'APP_DOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRWOOS0062' AND KEY_9 = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT HD.DOCU_NO , HD.USER_ID , HD.USER_NM , HD.DOCU_KN , HD.DOCU_TITLE , HD.DOCU_CONT , HD.PASS_STATUS , DT1.PASS_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE , DT1.ORDER_NO , LR1.LEGACY_USER_ID AS PASS_USER_ID , DT1.USER_NM AS PASS_USER_NM , DT1.PASS_ADD , DT1.PASS_KN , DT1.PASS_DATE , DT1.PASS_TP , LR2.LEGACY_USER_ID AS NEXT_USER_ID , DT2.USER_NM AS NEXT_USER_NM FROM ICOGDOCU HD INNER JOIN ICOGPASSLN DT1 ON (1 = 1 AND DT1.COMPANY = HD.COMPANY AND DT1.DOCU_NO = HD.DOCU_NO AND DT1.ORDER_NO = (HD.CUR_ORDER_NO - 1) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMLUSR LR1 ON (1 = 1 AND LR1.USER_ID = DT1.USER_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOGPASSLN DT2 ON (1 = 1 AND DT2.COMPANY = HD.COMPANY AND DT2.DOCU_NO = HD.DOCU_NO AND DT2.ORDER_NO = HD.CUR_ORDER_NO ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMLUSR LR2 ON (1 = 1 AND LR2.USER_ID = DT2.USER_ID ) WHERE HD.COMPANY = '$G_RS.COMPANY$' AND HD.DOCU_NO = '$G_RS.DOCU_NO$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y' , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'APP_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.COMPANY$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.DOCU_NO$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E' , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'APP_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.COMPANY$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.DOCU_NO$'
